conflicts.resolution: Reviewed current producer product page explicitly declares ASTM A536 conformance. Historical 0319 similar wording retained; no approximate steel equivalence is adopted.

field_status.reason: Exact normalized 1045 bar product standard is not declared by the producer; nearest-designation list and supply states do not validate the old +N identity. C45 is not substituted.
Existing T6 tube/pipe identity lacks a confirmed applicable product standard and solid manifold stock form; independently specified T651 plate is selectable.
Generic S355 does not establish exact suffix/state/product form. SSAB documents a distinct S355J2+N structural plate; generic S355 cannot inherit it.
Producer-specific T6511B manifold bar is documented, but its applicable product standard is not declared in this brochure. Do not equate it with T651 or T6.
Specific S355J2+N structural plate identity is supported, but no manifold-block application need was established in this bounded core review; not promoted merely to fill the count.

research_notes: No intrinsic material allowable/design stress found; project policy remains separate.
Published plate/bar ranges are provenance only, not discrete engineering stock; supplier inventory is not admitted.
Existing ten research identities and their original grade/state/standard/form are immutable; this supplement adds reviewed delivery context and separate exact new identities.
No treatment is selected. Existing treatment references on reviewed identities remain; no T6-to-T651 treatment inheritance is inferred.
